description: KNaSmNbO₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. K is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. Sm is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Sm-O bond lengths are 2.47 Å. Nb is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.87 Å) and four longer (1.98 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom to form distorted OK₄NaNb octahedra that share corners with four equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra, corners with eight equivalent ONaSm₂Nb tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Sm, and one Nb atom to form distorted ONaSm₂Nb tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra, corners with ten equivalent ONaSm₂Nb tetrahedra, and edges with five equivalent ONaSm₂Nb tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 71-72°.
